hints.title: Modular Remainder Transition
hints.text: Notice that appending a digit '1' to a number x transforms it to 10 * x + 1.

hints.title: Track Remainder
hints.text: Maintain rem = (rem * 10 + 1) % k. If rem == 0, the current length is the answer.

hints.title: Pigeonhole Principle
hints.text: By the pigeonhole principle, if k is not divisible by 2 or 5, a zero remainder will be found within at most k iterations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: At most k iterations before remainder repeats.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing the actual repunit as an arbitrary-precision integer causes memory overflow and quadratic division time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modular arithmetic keeps state in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects modular arithmetic and pigeonhole termination guarantee.
